name: FDTT n78 throughput with and without overlapping operators
description: Compare, per campaign, the FDTT throughput of the n78 sessions of each operator with and without a session of another operator on the same NR-ARFCN at the same time.
query_sql:
WITH fdtt AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    source_dataset_id, source_row_id, Campaign, Operator, Test_Name, Test_Start_Time, Test_End_Time,
    Mean_Data_Rate, NR_DL_PCell_ARFCN
  FROM selected_data
  WHERE Test_Name IN ('FDTT http DL MT', 'FDTT UDP UL ST')
    AND Test_Result = 'Completed'
    AND (NR_DL_PCell_Band LIKE '%78%' OR CAST(NR_B78_Total_Time AS REAL) > 0)
    AND NR_DL_PCell_ARFCN IS NOT NULL
), overlapping_sessions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.source_dataset_id, f.source_row_id
  FROM fdtt f
  JOIN fdtt o
    ON o.Campaign = f.Campaign
   AND o.NR_DL_PCell_ARFCN = f.NR_DL_PCell_ARFCN
   AND o.Test_Start_Time < f.Test_End_Time
   AND o.Test_End_Time > f.Test_Start_Time
   AND lower(o.Operator) <> lower(f.Operator)
), classified AS (
  SELECT f.*, overlapping_sessions.source_row_id IS NOT NULL AS overlapping
  FROM fdtt f
  LEFT JOIN overlapping_sessions
    ON overlapping_sessions.source_dataset_id = f.source_dataset_id
   AND overlapping_sessions.source_row_id = f.source_row_id
)
SELECT Campaign AS campaign, Operator AS operator, Test_Name AS test_name,
       SUM(overlapping) AS overlap_sessions,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN overlapping THEN CAST(Mean_Data_Rate AS REAL) END), 2) AS overlap_avg_Mean_Data_Rate,
       SUM(NOT overlapping) AS non_overlap_sessions,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN NOT overlapping THEN CAST(Mean_Data_Rate AS REAL) END), 2) AS non_overlap_avg_Mean_Data_Rate
FROM classified
GROUP BY Campaign, Operator, Test_Name
ORDER BY Campaign, Operator, Test_Name
